title: Creating Your First Store
description: Step-by-step guide to creating your first online store in Matjrii.
content:
Creating Your First Store

Creating a store in Matjrii is quick and easy. Follow these steps to get your store up and running.

Step 1: Navigate to Stores

From the dashboard sidebar, click on "Stores" in the navigation menu.

Step 2: Click Create Store

Click the "Create Store" or "New Store" button at the top of the stores page.

Step 3: Fill in Store Information

You'll need to provide:

  • Store Name: The name of your store (e.g., "My Fashion Store")
  • Store Slug: A URL-friendly version of your store name (e.g., "my-fashion-store")
  • Description: A brief description of your store
  • Theme: Choose from 10+ professional themes
  • Logo: Upload your store logo

Step 4: Configure Store Settings

After creating the basic information, you can configure:

  • Store status (active/inactive)
  • Featured status
  • Contact information
  • Social media links

Step 5: Save and Continue

Click "Save" to create your store. You'll be redirected to the store management page where you can further customize your store.

Next Steps

After creating your store, you may want to:

  • Configure store settings
  • Add products
  • Customize your store theme
meta_description: Learn how to create your first online store in Matjrii with step-by-step instructions.
